text: Why don't we just appoint someone to do it?
We will just appoint someone to do it, and everyone can agree who that person is going to be.
We select one person and he'll go ahead and do it on behalf of all of us.
And this was a wise old man, and out of respect for him, they said, "Okay, okay, we will agree to your way of getting out of this dilemma."
So then they thought to themselves and they started speaking among themselves, "Okay, who should we select? Who should do it?"

So then they decided, "Okay, we agree that the first person who comes in through [[Bab Bani Shaybah|باب بني شيبة]], the gate of [[Bani Shaybah|بني شيبة]]..." And there were many gates of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] that people used to come in,
many gates around the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] where people used to enter the [[Haram|حرم]].
So they agreed among themselves, "The first man who walks in through [[Bab Bani Shaybah|باب بني شيبة]], through the gate of [[Bani Shaybah|بني شيبة]], he is the one who gets to do it."
So they waited, waited, looking at that gate, waiting for someone to come in.
And finally, [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ walks through that gate.
And when he walks in, everyone is so happy. They say, "[[al-Sadiq al-Amin|الصَّادِق الأَمِين]]! [[al-Sadiq al-Amin|الصَّادِق الأَمِين]]! [[radina|رضينا]]! [[radina|رضينا]]!"
"The truthful one, the trustworthy one! The truthful one, the trustworthy one! We're happy with this, we're happy! Yes, he is the one who's going to do it."

So everyone was happy, because [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ had this reputation. Everybody loved him, everybody respected him, everybody honored him, and everyone knew how honorable and truthful and trustworthy he was. So they were very happy.
that he is the one who came through that gate. So he comes in,
and he takes a cloth and he puts the [[al-Hajar al-Aswad|الحجر الأسود]] on that cloth.
And then he tells the leaders of these different sub-tribes of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]],
someone from [[Banu Makhzum|بَنِي مَخْزُوم]], someone from [[Banu Abd al-Dar|بَنِي عَبْد الدَّار]],
all of them, you hold a piece of that cloth where the stone is in the middle.
So each one of them, they hold around that cloth and they walk
towards the corner of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] where the stone is supposed to be placed.
So all of them are participating here. Nobody is left out. All of them are participating.
And then when they get near the corner, [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] › with his blessed hand, he takes the stone and puts it in its place.
This again shows the [[hikmah|حكمة]] and the intelligence of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ›, how he diffused such a situation
and made everyone happy. They all participated in this way,
and [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] › himself put that stone in its place. So this is the story
of the reconstruction of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] that happened five years before the first [[wahy|واف]] came to [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ›.
And this was when he was about thirty-five years old. [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] next week we will talk about
some incidents that happened before the [[wahy|واف]] started, from the age of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ›
between thirty-five and forty. [[Wallahu a'lam|وَاللهُ أَعْلَم]].

en: And may Allah's peace, blessings and prayers be upon our Prophet Muhammad and upon his family and all his companions.
translit: wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ȹalā Nabiyyinā Muḥammad wa-ȹalā ālihī wa-ṣaḥbihī ajmaȹīn
